WITH revenue_2024 AS (
    SELECT 
        cik,
        ticker,
        name,
        value AS revenue_2024
    FROM v_revenue
    WHERE fiscal_year = 2024
),
revenue_2025 AS (
    SELECT 
        cik,
        ticker,
        name,
        value AS revenue_2025
    FROM v_revenue
    WHERE fiscal_year = 2025
),
revenue_comparison AS (
    SELECT 
        r2024.cik,
        r2024.ticker,
        r2024.name,
        r2024.revenue_2024,
        r2025.revenue_2025,
        CASE 
            WHEN r2024.revenue_2024 IS NOT NULL AND r2025.revenue_2025 IS NOT NULL THEN
                (r2025.revenue_2025 - r2024.revenue_2024) / r2024.revenue_2024 * 100
            ELSE NULL
        END AS growth_percentage
    FROM revenue_2024 r2024
    INNER JOIN revenue_2025 r2025 ON r2024.cik = r2025.cik
)
SELECT 
    name
FROM revenue_comparison
WHERE growth_percentage IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY growth_percentage DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH company_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        name,
        MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 2024 THEN value END) AS revenue_2024,
        MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 2025 THEN value END) AS revenue_2025
    FROM v_revenue
    WHERE fiscal_year IN (2024, 2025)
    GROUP BY name
    HAVING revenue_2024 IS NOT NULL AND revenue_2025 IS NOT NULL
),
growth_calculation AS (
    SELECT 
        name,
        ((revenue_2025 - revenue_2024) / revenue_2024) * 100 AS growth_percentage
    FROM company_revenue
)
SELECT name
FROM growth_calculation
ORDER BY growth_percentage DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH companies_with_both_years AS (
    SELECT cik, name
    FROM v_revenue
    WHERE fiscal_year IN (2024, 2025)
    GROUP BY cik, name
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT fiscal_year) = 2
),
revenue_by_year AS (
    SELECT 
        r.cik,
        r.name,
        MAX(CASE WHEN r.fiscal_year = 2024 THEN r.value END) AS revenue_2024,
        MAX(CASE WHEN r.fiscal_year = 2025 THEN r.value END) AS revenue_2025
    FROM v_revenue r
    INNER JOIN companies_with_both_years c ON r.cik = c.cik
    WHERE r.fiscal_year IN (2024, 2025)
    GROUP BY r.cik, r.name
),
growth_calculation AS (
    SELECT 
        name,
        CASE 
            WHEN revenue_2024 > 0 THEN ((revenue_2025 - revenue_2024) / revenue_2024) * 100
            WHEN revenue_2024 = 0 AND revenue_2025 > 0 THEN 100
            WHEN revenue_2024 = 0 AND revenue_2025 = 0 THEN 0
            ELSE NULL 
        END AS growth_rate
    FROM revenue_by_year
)
SELECT name
FROM growth_calculation
WHERE growth_rate IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY growth_rate DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT name
FROM (
    SELECT 
        r2024.name,
        ((r2025.value - r2024.value) / r2024.value) * 100 AS growth_percentage

    INNER JOIN v_revenue r2025 ON r2024.cik = r2025.cik
    WHERE r2024.fiscal_year = 2024 
        AND r2025.fiscal_year = 2025
        AND r2024.value > 0  -- Avoid division by zero
    ORDER BY growth_percentage DESC
    LIMIT 1
)

),

    FROM v_revenue r

SELECT ticker, ((f2025.value - f2024.value) / f2024.value) * 100 AS yoy_growth
FROM v_revenue f2024
JOIN v_revenue f2025 ON f2024.cik = f2025.cik AND f2024.fiscal_year = 2024 AND f2025.fiscal_year = 2025
ORDER BY yoy_growth DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT ticker, ((value_2025 - value_2024) / value_2024) * 100 AS yoy_growth
FROM (
    SELECT 
        r2024.ticker,
        r2024.value AS value_2024,
        r2025.value AS value_2025
    FROM 
        v_revenue r2024
    JOIN 
        v_revenue r2025 ON r2024.ticker = r2025.ticker
    WHERE 
        r2024.fiscal_year = 2024 AND r2025.fiscal_year = 2025
) sub
ORDER BY yoy_growth DESC
LIMIT 1

FROM (
    SELECT 
        r1.ticker,
        r1.value AS value_2024,
        r2.value AS value_2025
    FROM v_revenue r1
    JOIN v_revenue r2 ON r1.ticker = r2.ticker AND r1.fiscal_year = 2024 AND r2.fiscal_year = 2025
) subquery
ORDER BY growth_rate DESC
LIMIT 1

) subquery
WHERE value_2024 IS NOT NULL AND value_2025 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY growth_rate DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH high_revenue_companies AS (
    SELECT 
        c.name,
        vr.value AS revenue,
        vni.value AS net_income
    FROM 
        v_revenue vr
    JOIN 
        v_net_income vni ON vr.cik = vni.cik AND vr.fiscal_year = vni.fiscal_year
    JOIN 
        companies c ON vr.cik = c.cik
    WHERE 
        vr.fiscal_year = 2024
        AND vr.qtrs = 4
        AND vr.uom = 'USD'
        AND vni.fiscal_year = 2024
        AND vni.qtrs = 4
        AND vni.uom = 'USD'
        AND vr.value > 100000000000 -- revenue over $100 billion
)
SELECT 
    name,
    (net_income / revenue) AS net_margin
FROM 
    high_revenue_companies
ORDER BY 
    net_margin DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    c.name AS company_name,
    vr.value AS revenue,
    vni.value AS net_income,
    (vni.value / vr.value) AS net_margin
FROM 
    v_revenue vr
JOIN 
    v_net_income vni ON vr.cik = vni.cik AND vr.fiscal_year = vni.fiscal_year
JOIN 
    companies c ON vr.cik = c.cik
WHERE 
    vr.fiscal_year = 2024
    AND vr.qtrs = 4
    AND vr.value > 100000000000
ORDER BY 
    net_margin DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    c.name AS company_name,
    c.ticker,
    (vni.value / vr.value) * 100 AS net_margin
FROM 
    companies c
JOIN 
    v_revenue vr ON c.cik = vr.cik AND vr.fiscal_year = 2024 AND vr.fiscal_period = 'FY'
JOIN 
    v_net_income vni ON c.cik = vni.cik AND vni.fiscal_year = 2024 AND vni.fiscal_period = 'FY'
WHERE 
    vr.value > 100000000000 -- Revenue over $100 billion
ORDER BY 
    net_margin DESC
LIMIT 1;

FROM 
    v_revenue v_rev
JOIN 
    v_net_income v_ni ON v_rev.cik = v_ni.cik AND v_rev.fiscal_year = v_ni.fiscal_year
JOIN 
    companies c ON v_rev.cik = c.cik
WHERE 
    v_rev.fiscal_year = 2024
    AND v_rev.qtrs = 4
    AND v_rev.value > 100000000000
ORDER BY 
    net_margin DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    c.name,
    (vni.value / vr.value) * 100 AS net_margin
FROM 
    v_revenue vr
JOIN 
    v_net_income vni ON vr.cik = vni.cik AND vr.fiscal_year = vni.fiscal_year
JOIN 
    companies c ON vr.cik = c.cik
WHERE

    AND vr.qtrs = 4
    AND vni.qtrs = 4

WITH apple_data AS (
    SELECT 
        vr.value AS revenue,
        vni.value AS net_income
    FROM 
        v_revenue vr
    JOIN 
        v_net_income vni ON vr.cik = vni.cik AND vr.fiscal_year = vni.fiscal_year
    WHERE 
        vr.ticker = 'AAPL' AND vr.fiscal_year = 2024 AND vr.qtrs = 4
),
microsoft_data AS (
    SELECT 
        vr.value AS revenue,
        vni.value AS net_income
    FROM 
        v_revenue vr
    JOIN 
        v_net_income vni ON vr.cik = vni.cik AND vr.fiscal_year = vni.fiscal_year
    WHERE 
        vr.ticker = 'MSFT' AND vr.fiscal_year = 2024 AND vr.qtrs = 4
)
SELECT 
    (ad.net_income / ad.revenue) * 100 AS apple_net_margin,
    (md.net_income / md.revenue) * 100 AS microsoft_net_margin
FROM 
    apple_data ad, microsoft_data md;

WITH apple_data AS (
    SELECT 
        v_revenue.value AS revenue,
        v_net_income.value AS net_income
    FROM 
        v_revenue
    JOIN 
        v_net_income ON v_revenue.cik = v_net_income.cik AND v_revenue.fiscal_year = v_net_income.fiscal_year
    JOIN 
        companies ON v_revenue.cik = companies.cik
    WHERE 
        companies.name = 'Apple Inc.' AND v_revenue.fiscal_year = 2024 AND v_revenue.fiscal_period = 'FY'
),
microsoft_data AS (
    SELECT 
        v_revenue.value AS revenue,
        v_net_income.value AS net_income
    FROM 
        v_revenue
    JOIN 
        v_net_income ON v_revenue.cik = v_net_income.cik AND v_revenue.fiscal_year = v_net_income.fiscal_year
    JOIN 
        companies ON v_revenue.cik = companies.cik
    WHERE 
        companies.name = 'Microsoft Corporation' AND v_revenue.fiscal_year = 2024 AND v_revenue.fiscal_period = 'FY'
)
SELECT 
    (apple.net_income / apple.revenue * 100) AS apple_net_margin,
    (microsoft.net_income / microsoft.revenue * 100) AS microsoft_net_margin
FROM 
    apple_data apple, 
    microsoft_data microsoft;

SELECT 
    'Apple' AS company,
    (ni.value / rev.value) * 100 AS net_margin
FROM 
    v_revenue rev
JOIN 
    v_net_income ni ON rev.cik = ni.cik AND rev.fiscal_year = ni.fiscal_year
JOIN 
    companies c ON rev.cik = c.cik
WHERE 
    c.name = 'Apple Inc.'
    AND rev.fiscal_year = 2024
    AND rev.fiscal_period = 'FY'
    AND ni.fiscal_period = 'FY'

UNION ALL

SELECT 
    'Microsoft' AS company,
    (ni.value / rev.value) * 100 AS net_margin
FROM 
    v_revenue rev
JOIN 
    v_net_income ni ON rev.cik = ni.cik AND rev.fiscal_year = ni.fiscal_year
JOIN 
    companies c ON rev.cik = c.cik
WHERE 
    c.name = 'Microsoft Corporation'
    AND rev.fiscal_year = 2024
    AND rev.fiscal_period = 'FY'
    AND ni.fiscal_period = 'FY';

SELECT 
    a.name AS apple_name,
    m.name AS microsoft_name,
    a.net_margin AS apple_net_margin,
    m.net_margin AS microsoft_net_margin
FROM (
    SELECT 
        vni.name,
        (vni.value / vr.value) * 100 AS net_margin
    FROM

        COUNT(*) OVER () AS cnt

    SELECT value
    FROM v_total_assets
    WHERE fiscal_year = 2024
    ORDER BY value
    LIMIT 2 - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v_total_assets WHERE fiscal_year = 2024) % 2    -- either 1 or 2
    OFFSET (SELECT (COUNT(*) - 1) / 2 FROM v_total_assets WHERE fiscal_year = 2024)
) AS median_values;

      AND f.form = '10-K'

-- Calculate the percentage growth in Apple's revenue from fiscal year 2024 to fiscal year 2025
WITH revenue_data AS (
    SELECT 
        fiscal_year,
        value AS revenue
    FROM 
        v_revenue
    WHERE 
        ticker = 'AAPL'
        AND fiscal_year IN (2024, 2025)
        AND qtrs = 4
)
SELECT 
    ((MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 2025 THEN revenue END) - MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 2024 THEN revenue END)) / 
     MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 2024 THEN revenue END)) * 100 AS percentage_growth
FROM 
    revenue_data;

    ((r2025.value - r2024.value) / r2024.value) * 100 AS revenue_growth_percentage
FROM 
    v_revenue r2024
JOIN 
    v_revenue r2025 ON r2024.cik = r2025.cik AND r2024.ticker = r2025.ticker
WHERE 
    r2024.fiscal_year = 2024 AND r2024.fiscal_period = 'FY'
    AND r2025.fiscal_year = 2025 AND r2025.fiscal_period = 'FY'
    AND r2024.ticker = 'AAPL';

WITH revenue_2024 AS (
    SELECT cik, value AS revenue_2024
    FROM v_revenue
    WHERE fiscal_year = 2024 AND qtrs = 4
),
revenue_2025 AS (
    SELECT cik, value AS revenue_2025
    FROM v_revenue
    WHERE fiscal_year = 2025 AND qtrs = 4
),
growth_rates AS (
    SELECT 
        r24.cik,
        (r25.revenue_2025 - r24.revenue_2024) / r24.revenue_2024 AS growth_rate
    FROM revenue_2024 r24
    JOIN revenue_2025 r25 ON r24.cik = r25.cik
)
SELECT c.name
FROM growth_rates gr
JOIN companies c ON gr.cik = c.cik
ORDER BY gr.growth_rate DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    a.ticker AS apple_ticker,
    (a.value / b.value) * 100 AS apple_net_margin,
    m.ticker AS microsoft_ticker,
    (m.value / n.value) * 100 AS microsoft_net_margin
FROM 
    v_net_income a
JOIN 
    v_revenue b ON a.cik = b.cik AND a.fiscal_year = b.fiscal_year
JOIN 
    v_net_income m ON a.fiscal_year = m.fiscal_year
JOIN 
    v_revenue n ON m.cik = n.cik AND m.fiscal_year = n.fiscal_year
WHERE 
    a.ticker = 'AAPL' AND b.ticker = 'AAPL' AND
    m.ticker = 'MSFT' AND n.ticker = 'MSFT' AND
